```lean
theorem lg_target (a b c : ℝ) (ha : 0 < a) (hb : 0 < b) (hc : 0 < c) : a / b + b / c + c / a ≥ 3 := by
  have h1 : (a / b) * (b / c) * (c / a) = 1 := by
    rw [mul_assoc, mul_left_comm, mul_inv_cancel_right, mul_one]
  have h2 : (a / b + b / c + c / a) / 3 ≥ ((a / b) * (b / c) * (c / a))^(1/3) :=
    by apply real.am_gm_three (a / b) (b / c) (c / a)
  have h3 : ((a / b) * (b / c) * (c / a))^(1/3) = 1 := by rw [h1, pow_one]
  rw [h3] at h2
  exact h2.mul_both_sides (by norm_num)
```
